visual_description: A small, rectangular white satellite dish mounted on a low tripod. It is tilted toward the sky. A single shielded cable runs from the dish into the command tent. A small green LED on the side indicates a 'Linked' status.

constraints.logic: Enables 'Cloud Syncing' of field data to the Museum Lab in real-time.
constraints.background: Placed on a high, flat rock clear of any obstructions.
